editorial: Late-night conversations feel suddenly electric as the film pulls you into a maze of secrets. Its genre-mixing rhythm—half-blazing rom-com and half-deadpan thriller—keeps you on edge, refusing to settle into any single groove. The standout moment is the scene where silence itself becomes a character, letting the spaces between dialogue burst with unsaid tension. You’ll love this if you enjoy a darkly comic nightcap that blurs romance and suspense.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of rom-coms with a twist of thriller who like their romance seasoned with subtle dread.
watchReasons: sharp dialogue that keeps you guessing
